ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - EDRSilencer Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of EDRSilencer, a tool that leverages Windows Filtering Platform (WFP) to block Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents from reporting security events to the server based on PE metadata information.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\EDRSilencer\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "EDRSilencer\.exe" OR process_description = RGX(".*EDRSilencer.*"))
